text:
maria: Heads-up — planning a dedicated capacity cutover tonight (evening window). Target 22:00 UTC. This touches gpu-pool-prod (slice B) and an autoscale policy tweak (min=2 -> min=3). Need owners + smoke/rollback plan.
sam: I can own the orchestration and smoke runs. Will be on call at 21:30 UTC.
dennis: I can handle rollback scripts and eviction checks. Where should I put the rollback commands?
maria: put them in the release runbook under the deploy ticket (ENG-5643), but paste a quick snippet here for fast access.
leo: I'll do canary traffic cutover and monitor latency dashboards. I'll also run the kv-cache warmup after cut.
maria: deploy-bot scheduled window created: 22:00 UTC -> 22:30 UTC. If we don't hit smoke success by 22:15 we'll rollback. :warning:
deploy-bot: deploy scheduled by maria for gpu-pool-prod slice-B at 2026-03-17T22:00:00Z (ticket ENG-5643).
sam: Smoke checklist (I'll run):
```
# quick smoke commands
kubectl -n inference rollout status deploy/gpu-pool-prod-slice-b --timeout=5m
curl -sS -H "Authorization: Bearer $TEST_KEY" https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"smoke test","max_tokens":8}' | jq .choices[0].text
observe token latency via /internal/metrics?range=1m
```
sam: Will post smoke outputs to the ticket and here.
dennis: Rollback snippet (local ops):
```
# rollback to previous capacity + autoscale
kubectl -n infra set env deployment/gpu-pool-prod-slice-b MIN_REPLICAS=2
kubectl -n infra rollout restart deployment/gpu-pool-prod-slice-b
# also undo autoscale policy in policy-service
curl -X POST https://ops-api.internal/policies/patch -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"policy":"gpu-autoscale","min_replicas":2}'
```
leo: For monitoring I'll watch: console -> model_latency_p95, token_throughput, and the error_ratelimit counter. I'll post a short summary at +10m and +20m.
maria: Quick permissions check — @dennis do you have rights to call ops-api?
dennis: yes, I do. Tested earlier with the staging endpoint.
sam: One more ask — confirm rollback will not evict reserved workload tenants. We'll scale down slice B only.
maria: confirmed. Reserved tenants are pinned to slice-A, unaffected.
leo: Small note: after bumping min replicas we might see short-lived OOMs on startup for quantized models — will watch pod logs `kubectl logs -f`.
dennis: Good call. I'll tail logs for the first 2 mins post rollout.
sam: tagging ENG-SRE for visibility, @eng-sre please stand by for any quick rollback assist.
maria: final go/no-go timeline: 21:45 final check-in, 21:55 cutover freeze (no more changes), 22:00 kick deploy. If no blockers, I'll react with :rocket: here at 21:55.
leo: ack. I'll be in the channel.
deploy-bot: reminder scheduled in 30 minutes for deploy (ENG-5643).
maria: quick preflight items — 1) confirm canary traffic route exists 2) alert thresholds lowered to catch latency regressions 3) DB migrations? none. 4) perf test run? quick 1-min run done on staging. All green.
sam: sounds good. I'll paste smoke outputs after execution.
maria: thanks everyone — ping if you need to swap shifts. :thumbsup:
